newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER- GIGGS TO MISS WORLD CUP TIE VERSUS DUTCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER- GIGGS TO MISS WORLD CUP TIE VERSUS DUTCH.

text.p: English premier league club Manchester United on Monday informed Wales manager Bobby Gould that winger Ryan Giggs was unfit for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against the Netherlands in Eindhoven.
Giggs has missed Manchester United's last six games, including Saturday's home defeat against Chelsea, because of a calf strain.
Birmingham City's Jason Bowen, who was on standby for the European group seven clash, takes Giggs' place.
Giggs was suspended for Wales' 3-1 home defeat against the Dutch in Cardiff last month and his absence is a major blow for Gould, who is already without the suspended Mark Hughes.
